# LifeGauge Breeze™

> LifeGauge Breeze™ is a compact portable cooling and heating solution designed for year-round indoor comfort without complicated installation.

## Website

 URL: https://happylivingalways.com/breeze
 Product: LifeGauge Breeze™

## Key Features

 Portable cooling and heating
 No complicated installation
 7 operating modes
 Touchscreen and remote control
 Whisper-quiet operation
 Energy-saving mode
 Adjustable temperature
 Safety shutoff
 Coverage up to approximately 549 sq ft under suitable conditions

## Benefits

 Year-round comfort
 Easy setup
 Portable between rooms
 Cooling for hot weather
 Heating for colder conditions
 Quiet operation
